title: Observation Request
description: A request that a terminal run be observed by something that did not perform it. The executor may raise it - asking is not observing, and an executor that wants its work checked is the common case - but the request confers no independence on anyone. Whether a candidate may observe is settled by relation-inference over the run's own record, never by a field here.

subject.description: What is to be observed: the record the run acted on, addressed.

run_outcome.description: The run's terminal receipt outcome. A run still in flight cannot be observed; request-observation refuses RUN_NOT_TERMINAL.

durable_output_addresses.description: What an observer could read for itself, independent of any report. A request naming none leaves nothing to observe but the executor's word.

proposed_observer_id.description: Optional. A suggestion, not a claim. It must not be the requester: an executor nominating itself is the substitution this service exists to refuse.

predicate_declaration_id.description: Optional at request time. Predicates must exist before observe-run, not before the ask.

standing.description: A request enters RECORDED and is never lifted by this service. An observation answers it; the request does not answer itself.
